    • beanTypes

      public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types)
      Returns a BeanTypeList of legal bean types that the supplied Collection of TypeMirrors contains.

      The returned BeanTypeList may be empty.

      Parameters:
      types - a Collection of TypeMirrors; must not be null
      Returns:
      a BeanTypeList of legal bean types drawn from the supplied Collection; never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if types is null
      See Also:
      • Types.supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
      Idempotency:
      This method is idempotent and returns determinate values.
      Nullability:
      This method never returns null.
      Thread Safety:
      This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.

    • legalBeanType

      public static final boolean legalBeanType(TypeMirror t)
      Returns true if and only if the supplied TypeMirror is a legal bean type as defined by the CDI specification.

      Legal bean types are, exactly:

      1. Array types whose component types are legal bean types
      2. Primitive types
      3. Declared types that contain no wildcard types for every interpretation and level of containment
      Parameters:
      t - a TypeMirror; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if and only if t is a legal bean type; false otherwise
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if t is null
      See Also:
      • CDI-502
      • CDI issue 823
      • WELD-1492
      External Specifications
      • CDI Specification, version 4.1, section 2.2.1
      Idempotency:
      This method is idempotent and deterministic.
      Thread Safety:
      This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but TypeMirror implementations and Domain implementations may not be safe for such use.
